title: flutter-rebuild-direction: Measurement Harness and Analysis for the Direction of Flutter Widget Rebuild Cost
description: Measurement harness and analysis code. It builds the corpus, runs the on-device measurements on a Redmi 9T, and holds four notebooks that recompute every reported figure. The data is in flutter-rebuild-direction-data; the extractor and profiler are the spm package.
notes: Developed and maintained on GitHub as 32bytess (https://github.com/32bytess).
